title: The completed loader state is fixed
statement: For any natural number $l$, binary input word $x$, and configuration of the row loader on $x$, if its state is the final field index $l$ paired with the fresh loader’s initial reset control, then one machine step leaves the entire configuration unchanged.
hypotheses_covered: $c$ is a configuration of the row loader on $x$
the state of $c$ is the final field index $l$ paired with the fresh loader’s initial reset control
replaced: Every row-loader configuration whose control is the final field index with a fresh loader control is left entirely unchanged by one step, including the empty-row case.
